characters.name: thor
characters.description: Thor — the singer/narrator. Adult man, contemplative gaze, present and grounded. Aesthetic: wintry/poetic/noir palette (cool silvers, deep blues, candlelight warmth). Mood: introspective, listening to bells in the frozen night.

environments.name: frozen_belltower
environments.description: A snowy Gothic bell tower at night, silver bells just visible inside the arch. Bare frozen branches in the foreground. Cold blue moonlight, breath of mist. Painterly, slightly haunted, Poe-esque. Cinematic 16:9.

shots.description: The frozen bell tower at night. Silver bells glint inside the arch. Snowflakes drift. Slow push toward the bells. No people in frame.
Cut to Thor against the dark backdrop. He sings the latter half of the line with quiet intensity: "...how they tinkle and tinkle through the night." His breath is faintly visible.
